start.description: Once, as the call starts: after the start hook and the call-start lookup, before the greeting. A say comes before the greeting; end ends without it; form enters the form after the welcome (greeting_offer); anything-else is not taken here.

reason.description: Holds when the handoff's reason is this one, or one of this list (for example emergency, or [live-agent, frustrated]).

form.description: Holds when the form the caller is in (or, with none open, the last one completed on the call) is this one, or one of this list.

callData.description: A key of app.yaml's callData, tested by is, in, notIn or present beside it. A key the call came without fails is, in and notIn, and holds present: false.

fact.description: A value in the session's facts (what the app's code keeps), by its name or a dotted path to a nested one (account.tier), tested by is, in, notIn or present beside it. A fact that is not set (or null) fails is, in and notIn, and holds present: false; one that is a list or a record is present and equals no value.

slot.description: A slot's value as the call holds it (a form's slot, or one carried), tested by is, in, notIn or present beside it. An empty slot fails is, in and notIn, and holds present: false.

level.description: Holds when the caller is verified to at least this level: 1 (identity.yaml's factors) or 2 (the one-time code too).

hours.description: Holds when app.yaml's hours are open, or closed, at the time of the call; with schedule, a named schedule's (hours.schedules). An app with no such hours holds neither.

schedule.description: For hours: a schedule named under app.yaml's hours.schedules, in place of the default.

called.description: Holds when the number called is the value of this environment variable (env.<NAME>), or of one of this list. It needs app.yaml's callerNumber with called: true, so the number called is kept. The numbers stay in the environment, never in YAML.

named.description: Holds when the app's predicate of this name (code.predicates) returns true, given the session, read-only: for anything the other conditions cannot say.

present.description: For callData, fact or slot: true holds when there is a value, false when there is none.
